spanish: o se le hubiere hecho saber su pecado que pecó en ella, y traerá su ofrenda, macho cabrío de cabras, macho íntegro.
grammarChanges: Changed "se le hiciere saber" (simple future subjunctive, reads as open hypothetical) to "se le hubiere hecho saber" (future perfect subjunctive) so the clause renders the Hophal perfect as a completed passive event ("shall have been made known") inside the conditional, instead of a bare contingency.
